description: Change of use of the existing ground floor retail unit from Use Class E(a) to a nursery within Use Class E(f), including associated internal alterations, the provision of a rear play area, and the installation of a new fence, gate and bin store within the rear garden.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered location plan, 01 - Existing & Proposed Plans, 01 - Proposed Rear Yard Floor Plan, 02, 03, 04. Received: 10/07/2026.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The approved hours of operation for the ground floor unit as a nursery shall be as follows:

[09:00 - 17:00] Mondays � Fridays;
[closed] Saturdays, Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 5 - Prior to commencement of the use hereby approved, evidence shall have been submitted to the local planning authority for approval in writing to demonstrate that the premises has been fitted out to a specified internal noise insulation level above that required by British Standard BS8233:2014 and/or its subsequent amendments, so as to provide sound insulation against sudden and underlying noise generated by the approved use which might affect residential units located above or to the sides of the site. The site shall be used in such a manner as to ensure that the noise insulation measures so approved are effective at all times.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 6 - All refuse and recycling bins, or any other items linked to deliveries and collection in association with the approved development are to be stored within the premises at all times and only brought out onto the public highway when deliveries are being made or refuse collected.
Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway.
